title: Nostalgic Nutty Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A funky and bouncy Syrian dish featuring raspberry jam and a smoky heat, this recipe is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and perfect for a dinner gathering.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the lamb is grilling, mix the raspberry jam and minced garlic in a small bowl.
After the lamb has grilled for 8 minutes, brush the raspberry jam mixture onto the skewers.
Continue grilling for an additional 2-4 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped almonds.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
